description: This script contains functions for platform-specific operations in an OpenWrt firmware upgrade process, including retrieving root filesystem info, copying configuration, flashing kernel and root filesystem, performing upgrades, and checking images for specific devices.

methods.name: platform_get_rootfs
methods.description: Retrieves the root filesystem device from the kernel command line.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_helper
methods.description: Mounts the device, copies the backup configuration file to it, then unmounts.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration based on the specific board identified.

methods.name: platform_do_flash
methods.description: Flashes kernel and root filesystem from a tar archive to designated device partitions.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs system upgrade by mounting appropriate device and flashing the new images.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the integrity of the upgrade image for supported devices.
